statement: Chromatic splitting: filtrations and counterexamples. Disproves strong chromatic splitting at height three for primes p ≥ 5, and weak splitting for the derived p-completed sphere at heights p (p ≥ 5) and $`p+1`$ (p ≥ 7). Nevertheless, for n ≥ 1 and $`p\gt n+1`$, the overlap $`L_{n-1}L_{K(n)}S_p^\wedge`$ admits a $`2^n`$-stage filtration by the predicted localized-sphere pieces. At height three and prime three, even finite assembly from such pieces fails in the category of $`E(2)`$-local modules over the derived completed sphere.
